name: ctm360-hackerview
label: CTM360 Hackerview
description: HackerView is CTM360’s External Attack Surface Management platform, offering automated asset discovery, issue identification, security ratings, and third-party risk management. This collector lets you pull the issues and assets found on attack surface.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server
fields.tooltip: URL of the Hackerview server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: API Key
fields.name: api_key
fields.tooltip: API Key configured for your Hackerview server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.

operations.title: Get Issues
operations.description: Get list of issues found on your attack surface

parameters.title: First Seen
parameters.name: first_seen
parameters.tooltip: Apply a time filter to get all issues which were seen from this date onwards. Format should be DD-MM-YYYY hh:mm, for example "01-12-2021 03:14"

operations.title: Get Domains
operations.description: Get a list of your genuine domains

operations.title: Get Hosts
operations.description: Get a list of your genuine hostnames

operations.title: Get IP Addresses
operations.description: Get a list of your associated IP addresses

operations.title: Get Resolved Issues
operations.description: Get a list of issues found on your attack surface

parameters.title: From Date
parameters.name: from_date
parameters.tooltip: Apply a time filter to get all issues which were seen from this date onwards. Format should be DD-MM-YYYY hh:mm for example "01-12-2021 03:14"

parameters.title: To Date
parameters.name: to_date
parameters.tooltip: Apply a time filter to get all issues which were seen till this date. Format should be DD-MM-YYYY hh:mm for example "01-12-2021 03:14"
